records.name: Planck–Einstein relation
records.when_to_use: Photon energy from frequency or vacuum wavelength.
records.application: Light exchanges energy in discrete quanta hν.
records.lecture_reference: Confirmed: experimental lecture slide 24 (Zusammenfassung), Energiequantisierung; extended equivalents E=ℏω=hc/λ are standard but not shown on this slide.

records.name: Quantum harmonic-oscillator energy levels
records.when_to_use: Energy levels of a quantum harmonic oscillator; includes zero-point energy.
records.application: Each allowed energy is separated by ℏω.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Bose–Einstein mean occupation
records.when_to_use: Average number of thermal photons per mode at temperature T.
records.application: Photons have zero chemical potential in thermal equilibrium.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Mean thermal oscillator energy
records.when_to_use: Thermal energy excluding the zero-point term ℏω/2.
records.application: Multiply mean photon occupation by ℏω.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Planck law (frequency energy density)
records.when_to_use: Spectral energy density in a blackbody cavity in the frequency interval [ν,ν+dν]. The slide writes ω(ν)dν; equivalent to uν(T)dν.
records.application: Use the frequency density, not spectral radiance.
records.lecture_reference: Confirmed: experimental lecture slide 24 (Zusammenfassung), Schwarzkörperstrahlung.

records.name: Planck law (wavelength energy density)
records.when_to_use: Spectral energy density per unit wavelength; units J m⁻⁴.
records.application: uλ and uν are different densities; transform with |dν/dλ|.
records.lecture_reference: Wavelength form appears on the chalkboard in the supplied photo, but part of the expression is cut off; standard textbook expression, not fully slide-verified.

records.name: Rayleigh–Jeans law
records.when_to_use: Low-frequency, long-wavelength approximation to Planck's law.
records.application: Classical equipartition works only for hν ≪ kBT.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Wien's displacement law
records.when_to_use: Find the wavelength peak of blackbody spectral emission per wavelength.
records.application: Do not use the frequency-spectrum peak to infer the same λmax.
records.lecture_reference: Confirmed: experimental lecture slide 24 (Zusammenfassung), wavelength maximum.

records.name: Stefan–Boltzmann law
records.when_to_use: Total radiant power emitted by an ideal blackbody of surface area A and absolute temperature T; neglects environmental back-radiation.
records.application: Integrate blackbody radiation over all wavelengths.
records.lecture_reference: Confirmed: experimental lecture slide 24 (Zusammenfassung), Gesamtleistung and numerical Stefan–Boltzmann constant.

records.name: Greybody radiated power
records.when_to_use: Total emitted power for uniform temperature and constant effective emissivity ε.
records.application: Multiply blackbody emission by greybody emissivity.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Net radiative heat-transfer power
records.when_to_use: Approximate net exchange with a large isothermal black surrounding.
records.application: Subtract absorbed environmental radiation under the stated assumptions.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Stefan–Boltzmann constant
records.when_to_use: Relate the radiation constant to fundamental constants.
records.application: Derived by integrating Planck's spectral distribution.
records.lecture_reference: Numeric value confirmed on experimental lecture slide 24; fundamental-constant identity is a standard derivation, not printed on the slide.

records.name: Einstein photoelectric equation
records.when_to_use: Maximum photoelectron kinetic energy; ν must exceed threshold.
records.application: Photon energy pays work function; remainder becomes electron kinetic energy.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Photoelectric stopping potential
records.when_to_use: Find kinetic energy from magnitude of stopping voltage; e>0.
records.application: Stopping electric potential removes maximum kinetic energy.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Photoelectric threshold frequency
records.when_to_use: Minimum frequency for emission from a surface.
records.application: Set maximum kinetic energy to zero.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Compton wavelength shift
records.when_to_use: Wavelength shift for scattering from a free electron initially at rest.
records.application: Relativistic photon-electron collision predicts the shift.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Electron Compton wavelength
records.when_to_use: Characteristic electron length scale in Compton scattering.
records.application: Sets angular scale of wavelength shift.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Photon momentum
records.when_to_use: Magnitude of photon momentum in vacuum.
records.application: For massless particles E=pc.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: de Broglie wavelength
records.when_to_use: Matter-wave wavelength from momentum magnitude.
records.application: Particles exhibit wavelength inversely proportional to momentum.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Electron wavelength after acceleration
records.when_to_use: Electron accelerated from rest through positive voltage U, nonrelativistic.
records.application: Set kinetic energy p²/(2m)=eU, then λ=h/p.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Bragg diffraction law
records.when_to_use: Diffraction maxima from parallel crystal planes, θ measured to the planes.
records.application: Path difference between adjacent planes is 2d sinθ.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Diffraction-grating maxima condition
records.when_to_use: Principal diffraction maxima for a grating at normal incidence.
records.application: Adjacent slit path difference equals integer wavelengths.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Born probability density
records.when_to_use: Position probability density in one dimension.
records.application: Square wavefunction amplitude to obtain probability density.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Probability in a position interval
records.when_to_use: Probability of a 1D position measurement between a and b.

records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Wavefunction normalization
records.when_to_use: Normalization of a square-integrable 1D wavefunction.
records.application: Total probability must be one.
records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Position expectation value
records.when_to_use: Mean position for a normalized 1D state.

records.lecture_reference: Standard physics formula; inclusion in Franke experimental lectures NOT verified from the supplied slide.

records.name: Heisenberg uncertainty relation
records.when_to_use: Lower bound on standard deviations in one quantum state.

records.name: Rydberg formula
records.when_to_use: Hydrogen spectral emission wavelengths (reduced-mass corrected R_H).

records.name: Balmer series formula

records.name: Hydrogen energy levels

records.name: Atomic transition photon energy

records.name: Spin–orbit coupling Hamiltonian
